heading: Lifeboatmen
lead: To qualify for an endorsement as lifeboatman, an applicant must provide satisfactory proof that the applicant—

tree.text: has the service or training required by regulation;
is qualified professionally as demonstrated by examination; and
is qualified professionally by actual demonstration.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource section (U.S. Code) 731646:643(l) Section 7316 establishes the minimum standards an individual must meet in order to qualify for an endorsement as lifeboatman.
